sourceBinding.reason: Object-owned recipe: the datasets, their pinned program and bands, the stated conventions and the published geometry each is checked against.

The publisher's color map the dust dataset is shown in, read from the published figure as the file itself records (the color bar of MacGregor et al. (2017), Figure 1, left panel, decoded from the figure in the paper's arXiv source: linear from 0.0 to 0.8 mJy per beam, black at the low end and white at the high end. The printed panel is brighter than this scale gives: its colors read about 1.5 times the brightness cuts of the paper's Figure 5 on the panel's own bar, so the ring is drawn darker here than in print).
